description: A fixed voltage to each of up to sixteen channels of a polyphonic output, one knob per channel

params.text: The channel count; a cable at the CHAN input takes the count from that instead
The voltage sent to that numbered channel of the output

inputs.text: The channel count is taken from the polyphony of whatever is patched here, and the CHAN knob is ignored

outputs.text: A polyphonic output carrying each knob's voltage on its own numbered channel

notes: for putting deliberate variation across the channels of a poly voice
menu: Range — sets the voltage span the knobs cover: +/-10V, +/-5V, +/-3V, +/-2V, +/-1V, 0V-10V, 0V-5V, 0V-3V, 0V-2V or 0V-1V
